After wheat harvest, I will sow summer maize quickly so I do not lose moisture or time. I will use improved or hybrid seed because I want stable yield and less risk, but I will not make the management too complicated. I will stay with moderate fertilizer, practical irrigation, rotary tillage for convenience, and yields I believe are realistic for an ordinary year.
